<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">bio</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">email_verified</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">boolean</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">created_at</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">username_changed_at?</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">is_private</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">boolean</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// The *caller's* relationship to this profile. Only populated by</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// GET /users/:username and GET /users/me -- other endpoints that also</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// return a User-shaped object (search, followers/following lists) omit</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// it, since computing it per-row there would be N extra lookups.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">viewer_relationship</span><span class="o">?:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'self'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'following'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'requested'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'not_following'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// Reverse direction: does *this* profile have a pending request to</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// follow *me*? Lets accept/decline show up right on their profile page,</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// not just in the notification dropdown. Always false for your own</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// profile or when logged out.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">incoming_follow_request?</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">boolean</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// Whether this account is an admin/moderator (server computes this</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// against ADMIN_EMAILS -- see reports.rs / utils.rs). Only ever</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// populated by GET /users/me; login/register/refresh responses don't</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// set it, so it's undefined (falsy) until the next /users/me fetch --</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// matches viewer_relationship/incoming_follow_request's optionality</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// above. Display-only: the backend enforces the real check on every</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// /admin/* route regardless of what this says.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">is_admin?</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">boolean</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">Post</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">user_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">avatar_url</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">caption</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">created_at</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">edited_at</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">comment_count?</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">number</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">thumb_url?</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">medium_url?</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">full_url?</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// "hidden" posts never reach the client at all (server-side filtered)</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// except for the owner viewing their own profile -- "flagged" ones do</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// reach the client, and should render behind an interstitial warning.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">moderation_status</span><span class="o">?:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'visible'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'flagged'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'hidden'</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">MediaAsset</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">post_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">thumb_url</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">medium_url</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">full_url</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">width</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">number</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">height</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">number</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ProfileStats</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">followers</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">number</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">following</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">number</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">posts</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">number</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">LikeResponse</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">liked</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">boolean</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">like_count</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">number</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">AppNotification</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// 'message' only ever arrives over the SSE stream (see use-notifications.ts)</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// -- it's never persisted in the notifications table or returned by</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// notifications.list(), so the hook special-cases it instead of adding</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// it to the notification dropdown list.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">type_name</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'follow'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'post_like'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'comment'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'comment_like'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'message'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'follow_request'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'follow_accepted'</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">is_read</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">boolean</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">created_at</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">post_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// Raw storage key (not a full URL) for the related post's first image —</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// run through getMediaUrl() before rendering, same as Post.thumb_url.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// Always null for 'follow'/'follow_request'/'follow_accepted' (no post</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// involved; use actor.avatar_url instead) and 'message' (also no post).</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">post_thumb_url</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">actor</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">avatar_url</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">};</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">DiscoveryCursor</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">time</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">DiscoveryFeedResponse</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">data</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">Post</span><span class="p">[];</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">next_cursor</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">DiscoveryCursor</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">Comment</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">post_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">user_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">parent_comment_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">created_at</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">edited_at</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">like_count</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">number</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">liked</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">boolean</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">avatar_url</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// "hidden" comments never reach the client except for their own author</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// (server-side filtered) -- "flagged" ones do reach the client and</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// should render behind a lightweight interstitial for non-authors.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">moderation_status</span><span class="o">?:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'visible'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'flagged'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'hidden'</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">AuthResponse</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">access_token</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">refresh_token</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">user</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">User</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ApiError</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c1">// ── Token storage ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────</span>
<span class="c1">// klarsocial.eu and klarsocial.de are genuinely different top-level domains</span>
<span class="c1">// sharing one backend (api.klarsocial.eu) — every request is cross-site.</span>
<span class="c1">// Browsers increasingly block third-party cookies outright regardless of</span>
<span class="c1">// SameSite/Secure config (privacy-hardened Chromium forks, Safari ITP,</span>
<span class="c1">// Firefox ETP), so cookies can't be relied on as the sole auth mechanism.</span>
<span class="c1">// Tokens are stored in localStorage and sent explicitly via</span>
<span class="c1">// Authorization: Bearer instead — this bypasses cookie policy entirely,</span>
<span class="c1">// at the accepted tradeoff of XSS-exposed storage vs. httpOnly cookies.</span>

<span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ACCESS_KEY</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"klar_access_token"</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">REFRESH_KEY</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"klar_refresh_token"</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="kd">function</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">safeGetItem</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">key</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="ow">typeof</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">window</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">===</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"undefined"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">window</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">localStorage</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">getItem</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">key</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">tokens</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">getAccess</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">safeGetItem</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">ACCESS_KEY</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">getRefresh</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">safeGetItem</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">REFRESH_KEY</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">set</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">access</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">refresh</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="ow">typeof</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">window</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">===</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"undefined"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nb">window</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">localStorage</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">setItem</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">ACCESS_KEY</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">access</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nb">window</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">localStorage</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">setItem</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">REFRESH_KEY</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">refresh</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">clear</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="ow">typeof</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">window</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">===</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"undefined"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nb">window</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">localStorage</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">removeItem</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">ACCESS_KEY</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nb">window</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">localStorage</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">removeItem</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">REFRESH_KEY</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="c1">// ── Core fetch wrapper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────</span>

<span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">isRefreshing</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">false</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">failedQueue</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">Array</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">resolve</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">reject</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">any</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[];</span>

<span class="kd">function</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">processQueue</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">Error</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">failedQueue</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">forEach</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="nx">prom</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">prom</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">reject</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">prom</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">resolve</span><span class="p">();</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">});</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">failedQueue</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[];</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="kd">function</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">buildFetchOptions</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">options</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">RequestInit</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">RequestInit</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">headers</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">Record</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="s2">"Content-Type"</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"application/json"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">...(</span><span class="nx">options</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">headers</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">Record</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">};</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">accessToken</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">tokens</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">getAccess</span><span class="p">();</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">accessToken</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">headers</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"Authorization"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sb">`Bearer </span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">accessToken</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">...</span><span class="nx">options</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">headers</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// Kept for same-site/local-dev cases where the cookie does work — costs</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// nothing to also send it, and the Authorization header above is what</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// actually carries auth across the cross-site production domains.</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">credentials</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"include"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">};</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">async</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">function</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">T</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">path</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">options</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">RequestInit</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{},</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">authenticated</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">false</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">_isRetry</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">false</span>
<span class="p">)</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Promise</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">T</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetchOptions</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">buildFetchOptions</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">options</span><span class="p">);</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">API_URL</span><span class="si">}${</span><span class="nx">path</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetchOptions</span><span class="p">);</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">status</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">===</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">401</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">authenticated</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="nx">_isRetry</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">isRefreshing</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">new</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Promise</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">T</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="nx">resolve</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">reject</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">failedQueue</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">push</span><span class="p">({</span>
<span class="w">          </span><span class="nx">resolve</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="nx">resolve</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">              </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">API_URL</span><span class="si">}${</span><span class="nx">path</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">buildFetchOptions</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">options</span><span class="p">)).</span><span class="nx">then</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">async</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">r</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">                </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">r</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">status</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">===</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">204</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">undefined</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">T</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">                </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">text</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">r</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">text</span><span class="p">();</span>
<span class="w">                </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">text</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">?</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">JSON</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">parse</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">text</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">undefined</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">T</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">              </span><span class="p">})</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">          </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">          </span><span class="nx">reject</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">reject</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">});</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">});</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">isRefreshing</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">try</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="c1">// Cookie is sent as a best-effort fallback (credentials: include),</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="c1">// but the refresh_token in the body is what actually carries this</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="c1">// cross-site, since third-party cookies may be blocked entirely.</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">refreshRes</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">API_URL</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/auth/refresh`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">headers</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Content-Type"</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"application/json"</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">credentials</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"include"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">refresh_token</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">tokens.getRefresh</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">??</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">undefined</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">});</span>

<span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="nx">refreshRes</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">ok</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">throw</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">new</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ne">Error</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Refresh failed"</span><span class="p">);</span>

<span class="w">      </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">refreshed</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">refreshRes</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">json</span><span class="p">())</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">access_token</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">refresh_token</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">};</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">tokens</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">refreshed</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">access_token</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">refreshed</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">refresh_token</span><span class="p">);</span>

<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">processQueue</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">);</span>

<span class="w">      </span><span class="c1">// Retry the original request with the freshly stored access token</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">retryRes</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">API_URL</span><span class="si">}${</span><span class="nx">path</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">buildFetchOptions</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">options</span><span class="p">));</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">retryRes</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">status</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">===</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">204</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">undefined</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">T</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">retryText</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">retryRes</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">text</span><span class="p">();</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">retryText</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">?</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">JSON</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">parse</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">retryText</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">undefined</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">T</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">catch</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">processQueue</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ne">Error</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">tokens</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">clear</span><span class="p">();</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="k">throw</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">new</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ne">Error</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Session expired. Please log in again."</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">finally</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">isRefreshing</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">false</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">status</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">===</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">204</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">undefined</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">T</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// Some endpoints (e.g. chat edit/reaction) return 200 with an empty body —</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// read as text first so JSON.parse isn't called on an empty string.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">text</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">text</span><span class="p">();</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">data</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">text</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">?</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">JSON</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">parse</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">text</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">undefined</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">ok</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">throw</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">new</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ne">Error</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="nx">data</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ApiError</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">??</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Something went wrong"</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">data</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">T</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c1">// ── Auth endpoints ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">auth</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// acceptTerms is required and enforced server-side (POST /auth/register</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// rejects the request with 400 if it isn't true) -- see the register</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// handler and models::RegisterRequest on the backend. Previously this</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// checkbox was frontend-only and never reached the API at all.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">register</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">email</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">password</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">acceptTerms</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">boolean</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">AuthResponse</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/auth/register"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">email</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">password</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">accept_terms</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">acceptTerms</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">login</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">email</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">password</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">AuthResponse</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/auth/login"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">email</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">password</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">logout</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">refreshToken?</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/auth/logout"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">refresh_token</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">refreshToken</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">??</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">tokens</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">getRefresh</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">??</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">undefined</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">refresh</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">refreshToken?</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">access_token</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">refresh_token</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/auth/refresh"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">refresh_token</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">refreshToken</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">??</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">tokens</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">getRefresh</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">??</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">undefined</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">forgotPassword</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">email</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/auth/forgot-password"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">email</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">resetPassword</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">token</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">password</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/auth/reset-password"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">token</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">new_password</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">password</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">verifyEmail</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">token</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/auth/verify?token=</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nb">encodeURIComponent</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">token</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">resendVerification</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">email</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/auth/resend-verification"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">email</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="c1">// ── User endpoints ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">users</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">me</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">User</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/users/me"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">get</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">User</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/users/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">search</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">q</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">limit</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">20</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">offset</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">User</span><span class="p">[]</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="sb">`/users/search?q=</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nb">encodeURIComponent</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">q</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">&amp;limit=</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">limit</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">&amp;offset=</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">offset</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">stats</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">ProfileStats</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/users/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/stats`</span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">updateProfile</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">displayName</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">bio</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">isPrivate?</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">boolean</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">User</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="s2">"/users/me"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"PATCH"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">display_name</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">displayName</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">bio</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">is_private</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">isPrivate</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">??</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">})</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">changePassword</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">currentPassword</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">newPassword</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/users/me/password"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"PATCH"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">current_password</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">currentPassword</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">new_password</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">newPassword</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">deleteAccount</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/users/me"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"DELETE"</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">uploadAvatar</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">async</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">file</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">File</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Promise</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">User</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">form</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">new</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">FormData</span><span class="p">();</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">form</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"avatar"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">file</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">headers</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">Record</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{};</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">accessToken</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">tokens</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">getAccess</span><span class="p">();</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">accessToken</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">headers</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"Authorization"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sb">`Bearer </span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">accessToken</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">API_URL</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/users/me/avatar`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">credentials</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"include"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">headers</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">form</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">});</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">data</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">json</span><span class="p">();</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">ok</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">throw</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">new</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ne">Error</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="nx">data</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ApiError</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">??</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Upload failed"</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">data</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">User</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">},</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// Right of access / data portability (Art. 15 + 20 DSGVO): fetches the</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// full JSON export and triggers a browser download directly — bypasses</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// the shared `request()` wrapper since we need the raw Blob and the</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// filename from Content-Disposition, not parsed JSON to use in state.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">exportData</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">async</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Promise</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">headers</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">Record</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{};</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">accessToken</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">tokens</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">getAccess</span><span class="p">();</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">accessToken</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">headers</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"Authorization"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sb">`Bearer </span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">accessToken</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">API_URL</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/users/me/export`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"GET"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">credentials</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"include"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="nx">headers</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">});</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">ok</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">data</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">json</span><span class="p">().</span><span class="k">catch</span><span class="p">(()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="k">throw</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">new</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ne">Error</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="nx">data</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ApiError</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">??</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Export failed"</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">disposition</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">headers</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Content-Disposition"</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">match</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">disposition</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">match</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sr">/filename="(.+)"/</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">filename</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">match</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">.[</span><span class="mf">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">??</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"klar-datenexport.json"</span><span class="p">;</span>
