<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">blob</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">blob</span><span class="p">();</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">url</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">window</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">URL</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">createObjectURL</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">blob</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">a</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">document</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">createElement</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"a"</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">a</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">href</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">url</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">a</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">download</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">filename</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nb">document</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">appendChild</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">a</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">a</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">click</span><span class="p">();</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">a</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">remove</span><span class="p">();</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nb">window</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">URL</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">revokeObjectURL</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">url</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="c1">// ── Follow endpoints ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">FollowActionResponse</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">message</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// "following" for an immediate/accepted follow, "requested" if it went</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// to a private account and is now pending, "not_following" after an</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// unfollow/cancel-request.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">status</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'following'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'requested'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'not_following'</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">follows</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">follow</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">FollowActionResponse</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/users/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/follow`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// Also cancels a pending request, if that's what actually exists —</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// "unfollow" here really means "stop following / withdraw my request".</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">unfollow</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">FollowActionResponse</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/users/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/follow`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"DELETE"</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">followers</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">User</span><span class="p">[]</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/users/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/followers`</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">following</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">User</span><span class="p">[]</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/users/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/following`</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="c1">// ── Follow request endpoints (private accounts) ──────────────────────────────</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">FollowRequest</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">requester_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">requester_username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">requester_display_name</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">requester_avatar_url</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">created_at</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">followRequestsApi</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">list</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">FollowRequest</span><span class="p">[]</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/users/me/follow-requests"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">accept</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">requesterUsername</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/users/me/follow-requests/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">requesterUsername</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/accept`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">reject</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">requesterUsername</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/users/me/follow-requests/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">requesterUsername</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/reject`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="c1">// ── Reporting &amp; moderation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ReportReason</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'spam'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'harassment'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'hate_speech'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'violence'</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'self_harm'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'sexual_content'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'csam'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'impersonation'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'other'</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ReportTargetType</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'post'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'comment'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'user'</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">AdminReport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">reporter_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">reporter_username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// Only set after review (dismiss/remove) -- always null in the pending</span>

<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">target_type</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">targetType</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">target_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">targetId</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">reason</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">details</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">details</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">||</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">})</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="sb">`/admin/reports/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">reportId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/remove`</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">note</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">note</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">||</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">})</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span>

<span class="c1">// ── Post endpoints ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">},</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">get</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">Post</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/posts/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">params</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">new</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">URLSearchParams</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">limit</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">String</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">limit</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">});</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">cursor</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">params</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"cursor"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">cursor</span><span class="p">);</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">},</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">media</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">postId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">MediaAsset</span><span class="p">[]</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/posts/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">postId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/media`</span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="c1">// ── Block endpoints ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">list</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">AppNotification</span><span class="p">[]</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/notifications"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">blocks</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">block</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">message</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/users/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/block`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">unblock</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">message</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/users/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/block`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"DELETE"</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="c1">// ── Comment endpoints ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">comments</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">list</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">postId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">Comment</span><span class="p">[]</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/posts/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">postId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/comments`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">create</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">postId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">parentCommentId?</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">Comment</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="sb">`/posts/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">postId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/comments`</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span>
<span class="w">          </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">          </span><span class="nx">parent_comment_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">parentCommentId</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">??</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">edit</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">postId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">commentId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">Comment</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="sb">`/posts/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">postId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/comments/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">commentId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"PATCH"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">})</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="ow">delete</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">postId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">commentId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="sb">`/posts/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">postId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/comments/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">commentId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"DELETE"</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">toggleLike</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">postId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">commentId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">LikeResponse</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="sb">`/posts/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">postId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/comments/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">commentId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/like`</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="c1">// --- CHAT API ---</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ReactionEntry</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">emoji</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">user_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">Conversation</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">other_user_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">other_username</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">other_avatar_url</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// Whichever is more recent: the last message, or the last reaction on</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// any message in the conversation. null only for a brand new</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// conversation with no activity yet.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">last_activity_kind</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'message'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'reply'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'reaction'</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">last_activity_actor_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// Who wrote the message involved -- same as actor_id for</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// 'message'/'reply', but for 'reaction' this is who wrote the message</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// being reacted to (may differ from who reacted).</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">last_activity_message_sender_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">last_activity_text</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// Only set when last_activity_kind is 'reaction'.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">last_activity_emoji</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">updated_at</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ChatMessage</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">conversation_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">sender_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">created_at</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">edited_at</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">is_read</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">boolean</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">reply_to_message_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">reactions</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">ReactionEntry</span><span class="p">[];</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">chatsApi</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">getConversations</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">Conversation</span><span class="p">[]</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/chats"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">getMessages</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">conversationId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">ChatMessage</span><span class="p">[]</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/chats/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">conversationId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/messages`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">sendMessage</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">receiverId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">replyToId?</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nx">ChatMessage</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="s2">"/chats/send"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">receiver_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">receiverId</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">reply_to_message_id</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">replyToId</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">||</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">null</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">editMessage</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">messageId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="sb">`/chats/messages/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">messageId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"PATCH"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">})</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">deleteMessage</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">messageId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/chats/messages/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">messageId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"DELETE"</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">toggleReaction</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">messageId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">emoji</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="sb">`/chats/messages/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">messageId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/reactions`</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"POST"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">body</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">JSON.stringify</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">emoji</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">})</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">      </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// Total unread messages across every conversation, for the Chat icon's</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// red-dot badge (see use-notifications.ts, which also updates this</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// count live via the 'message' SSE event without re-fetching).</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">getUnreadCount</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">count</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">number</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/chats/unread-count"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>

<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// Called when a conversation is opened, so its messages stop counting</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// toward the unread badge.</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nx">markConversationRead</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">conversationId</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=&gt;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">request</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="ow">void</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`/chats/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">conversationId</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">/read`</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">method</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"PATCH"</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">};</span>
</pre></div></td></tr></table></div>

      </section>
    </main>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
